utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Bank holiday or not, here we are. Can you all hear me?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. Before we start, whose new car's that in the car park? Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with more dust than paint.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Someone's doing all right, then. Also, the heating in the portakabin — honestly, it's tropical in here. Just having a moan, not reporting a job.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Luxury. Normally you can see your breath on these calls.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the accommodation review. What's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I tested the water system yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's complete, then, rather than something carried into today?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, complete. Nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the line one yesterday. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, saw that on the handover. Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Only other thing from me on running conditions: saw the pressure on the stacker dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, did you say it's still down, or—?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, back on its own. Just an observation, not asking for a job off the back of it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Similar here. Saw the pressure on the heater box on one dip for a few minutes, then it came back on its own. Just passing that on.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, two brief dips, neither still sitting low. Got you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observations only. We're not turning those into new actions in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll run the monthly fire alarm test this morning.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's you doing it, boss, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, me. This morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, I can't get to the gas valve on one until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And there's no window agreed. I can't give you one on this call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Still blocked, not a commitment to get at it today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the wrapper as well. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the physical work. The near-miss write-up is separate, though.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Olumide, can you write up the near miss at the wrapper after lunch? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll write up the near miss at the wrapper after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. Normal priority, no need to treat the paperwork as an emergency.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Understood. That's mine, separate from the parts hold.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the shutdown on the boiler is cancelled now. Production need it running.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, cancelled, not just shifted a bit.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Good distinction. So there's no boiler shutdown going ahead under that plan.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. It's off.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Gas Turbine 1, at half two.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped slightly there. Half two?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: At half two, yeah. The risk assessment update, not the turbine work itself.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Reidy. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. I'll have that update at half two.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll chase the purchase order for the line 1 mould temp next week. It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Next week for the chase, then? Not saying the kit will be here next week?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. Chasing the purchase order, no delivery promise. Fairly important, but the chase is next week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Pricey, that's yours for next week.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I'll inspect the pump in the pit for leaks on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: On the 3rd, right. I nearly heard that as one for today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, on the 3rd. Not an emergency but don't let it slip — that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Fiona. The leak inspection on the 3rd is with you.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, mine.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, there's still the permit to work and isolation for the door switch on two. That needs sorting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, someone needs to sort the permit to work and isolation for the door switch on two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. Anyone able to own that?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'm raising the gap, rather than volunteering. I can't take ownership of that package.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, I can't take the whole permit and isolation package either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone else? Sorry, thought someone was coming in there.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Only me moving the headset. Not an offer, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That one's still got no owner, then. No date agreed either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. It needs doing, but nobody's taken it. Leave it explicitly unallocated, not against anyone by assumption.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Heard that. Teams makes every silence sound like someone's about to volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Dangerous game, breathing near your microphone.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll stay very still.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Agreed actions as discussed; blocked and cancelled work stays separate. Cheers, everyone.
